metadata.name: vicinity_curve
metadata.description: Vicinity Curve: one coin per city with its own bonding curve, graduation into its own pool, fee buckets, payouts and buyback-and-burn, without Meteora (VICINITY-CURVE-DESIGN.md)

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: 4.3. Step two of the admin transfer, signed by the proposed key.

instructions.name: add_launch_config
docs: 4.6. Add a split and curve for future coins (V1 to V11).

instructions.name: approve_launch
docs: 4.8. Approve one founder to launch one city's coin.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Pays the approval rent (refunded on close to `rent_payer = admin`).

accounts.name: legacy_launchpad
docs: read by hand: owner, size and discriminator, then `launches_paused`,
then its `admin` (this program's admin) and `pending_admin` (zero).

accounts.name: rewards_registry

program's admin and its `pending_admin` zero (8.4, OPS-1).

instructions.name: buy
docs: 4.11. Exact-in buy on the curve or in the pool.

accounts.name: user

system-owned account without data (14.3).

accounts.name: launchpad
docs: Only `buys_halted` is read.

accounts.name: user_token_account
docs: Any token account of this mint (a router may deliver to an account it
controls), except one whose authority is the `Coin` PDA (the vault or
any other), from which coins could never move again.

instructions.name: buyback_burn
docs: 4.13. Permissionless buyback-and-burn crank.

instructions.name: claim_founder_fees

instructions.name: clear_launch_batch

batch, optionally halting publication: a pure stop.

instructions.name: forward_holders_fees
docs: 4.15. Permissionless: pay `holders_pending` to the city's checked
`vicinity_rewards` WSOL vault (followed by a top-level `SyncNative`).

handler reads and checks its fields.

accounts.name: rewards_vault
docs: The city's rewards vault: derived from the config under the rewards
program, a classic WSOL token account owned by the config PDA.

instructions.name: init_launch_batch
docs: 4.23. One-time: the admin creates the `LaunchBatch` account (the batch
path stays off until a launch approver is set).

instructions.name: init_launchpad
docs: 4.1. One-time: create the global `Launchpad`. Only the program's upgrade
authority can call it; the admin signs too.

reads the upgrade authority from its 45-byte header.

types.name: CurveCoin
docs: One per city, permanent; seeds `["coin", city_id u64 LE]`; 693 bytes with
fixed offsets (3.7). This file calls it `Coin`; the Rust name gives it the
discriminator `sha256("account:CurveCoin")[..8]`, distinct from the old
program's `Coin`.
All of the coin's SOL is held as native lamports of this account
(`rent_reserve` + the reserve of its phase + the five buckets, plus any
donation); its coins sit in the vault PDA `["coin_vault", coin]`.

types.name: LaunchBatch
docs: One per program; seeds `["launch_batch"]`; 260 bytes (3.11). The two
most recent batch records the launch approver published, and the halt of
the batch path. Created once by the admin (`init_launch_batch`); written
only by `set_launch_approver`, `publish_launch_batch` and
`clear_launch_batch`; read by `launch_from_batch`; never read by a trade;
never closed. Which record is in force at a moment is
`batch::batch_in_force` (8.6).

docs: Offset 22. Sum of the five.

fields.name: virtual_sol
docs: Offset 24. `x0`.

fields.name: virtual_tokens
docs: Offset 32. `y0`.

fields.name: curve_supply
docs: Offset 40. `S`.

fields.name: pool_supply
docs: Offset 48. `P`.

fields.name: graduation_sol
docs: Offset 56. `R`, which must equal `f(S)`.

fields.name: launch_fee_lamports
docs: Offset 64. Paid to `FEE_RECIPIENT` at launch.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Offset 72.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Offset 80. Zero.

types.name: LaunchedFromBatch
docs: `launch_from_batch` (4.27), emitted right after its `CoinLaunched`: the
batch and the leaf the launch was checked against.

fields.name: root
docs: The root of that batch (3.11).

fields.name: leaf
docs: The leaf built from the call's arguments and its signer (3.12).

types.name: Launchpad
docs: One per program; seeds `["launchpad"]`; 238 bytes (3.4).
There is no fee-recipient field, no program-id field and no coin counter
(3.2). `buy` and `launch` read `buys_halted`, `buyback_burn` reads
`buybacks_halted`; `sell` never reads this account.
`buybacks_halted` implies `buys_halted` (`set_pause` refuses anything else,
review LL-1): no buyback backlog can build while anyone can buy ahead of it.
`launch_approver` is kept apart from every other role in both directions
(4.2, 4.4, 4.5, 4.24) and from every founder seat (`check_founder_key`).

fields.name: admin
docs: Offset 8. Approves launches, adds and enables configs, sets any pause
flag either way, sets the payout key and wallet and the guardian.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Offset 40. Second step of an admin transfer; zero = none.

fields.name: payout_authority
docs: Offset 72. Key that may run opted-in founder payouts; zero = off.

fields.name: payout_destination
docs: Offset 104. System-owned wallet that receives opted-in payouts; zero = off.

fields.name: guardian
docs: Offset 136. May only set `launches_paused`, `buys_halted` and
`buybacks_halted` to true; zero = none.

fields.name: launches_paused
docs: Offset 168. Blocks `launch`.

fields.name: payouts_paused
docs: Offset 169. Blocks `payout_founder_fees`.

fields.name: buys_halted
docs: Offset 170. Blocks `buy` and `launch`; never an exit.

fields.name: next_config_id
docs: Offset 171. Id of the next `LaunchConfig`; sequential from 0.

fields.name: bump
docs: Offset 173.

fields.name: buybacks_halted
docs: Offset 174. Blocks `buyback_burn`; set only while `buys_halted` is
(review LL-1). Taken from the reserved bytes: the size is unchanged.

fields.name: launch_approver
docs: Offset 175. The launch approver (3.4, 8.1): may only publish and clear
launch batches (4.25, 4.26); zero = none, the batch path off (the
default after `init_launchpad`). Written only by the admin's
`set_launch_approver` (4.24). Taken from the reserved bytes: the size
and every other offset are unchanged.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Offset 207. Zero.

types.name: LaunchpadInitialized
docs: `init_launchpad` (4.1).

types.name: PauseChanged
docs: `set_pause` (4.4): the flags after the change and who changed them.

types.name: PayoutConfigChanged
docs: `set_payout_config` (4.5).

types.name: PayoutOptIn
docs: One per coin while its founder is opted in; seeds `["payout_opt_in",
coin]`; 145 bytes (3.9).

fields.name: coin
docs: Offset 8.

fields.name: founder
docs: Offset 40. Who signed; must still equal `coin.founder` at every payout.

fields.name: agreed_destination
docs: Offset 72. Copy of `launchpad.payout_destination` when the founder
signed; every payout must match it and the current setting.

fields.name: ref_hash
docs: Offset 104. SHA-256 of the off-chain reference, never a name or an
account number.

fields.name: opted_in_at
docs: Offset 136.

fields.name: bump
docs: Offset 144.

types.name: PayoutOptInRevoked
docs: `revoke_payout_opt_in` (4.19).

fields.name: founder
docs: The founder who signed the opt-in.

types.name: PayoutOptedIn
docs: `opt_in_payout` (4.18).

types.name: PlatformFeesWithdrawn
docs: `withdraw_platform_fees` (4.14).

types.name: TickerLock
docs: One per ticker, permanent; seeds `["ticker", symbol bytes]`; 49 bytes (3.8).

fields.name: city_id
docs: Offset 8.

fields.name: mint
docs: Offset 16.

fields.name: bump
docs: Offset 48.

types.name: Trade
docs: Every `buy` and `sell` (4.11, 4.12).

fields.name: phase
docs: Phase the trade executed in (0 Curve, 1 Pool); a graduating buy
executes in phase 0.

fields.name: sol_in
docs: Buy: lamports offered (`sol_in`). Sell: 0.

fields.name: sol_amount
docs: Buy: lamports charged. Sell: gross lamports released before the fee.

fields.name: sol_net
docs: Buy: lamports into the curve or pool. Sell: lamports paid to the user.

fields.name: token_amount
docs: Raw coins bought or sold.

fields.name: liquidity_dripped
docs: Lamports moved from `liquidity_pending` into `pool_sol` (0 on the curve).

fields.name: partial
docs: `sol_amount < sol_in` (only the buy that completes the curve).

fields.name: graduated
docs: This buy completed the curve (a `Graduated` event follows).

fields.name: virtual_sol_after
docs: Virtual reserves of the market after the trade: curve
`(x0 + curve_sol, y0 - tokens_sold)`, pool `(pool_sol, pool_tokens)`.

fields.name: trade_seq
docs: +1 per trade, gap-free per coin.

constants.name: APPROVAL_MAX_SECS
docs: An approval lasts at most 30 days.

constants.name: BATCH_MAX_LEAD_SECS
docs: Latest `valid_from` after publication: a list is never signed long
before it takes force (4.25).

constants.name: BATCH_MAX_VALIDITY_SECS
docs: Longest window from `valid_from` to `valid_until` (4.25, O31).

constants.name: BATCH_REVIEW_SECS
docs: Least time from a launch batch's publication to its `valid_from`: the
review window in which the site's monitor recomputes the root, a second
person checks the new entries, and the guardian, the owner or the admin
can clear it (4.25, 8.6; owner decision O30).

constants.name: BPS
docs: Basis-point denominator `D`.

constants.name: BUYBACK_CAP_DIVISOR
docs: `C`: a buyback spends at most `depth * total_fee_bps / (C * D)`.

constants.name: BUYBACK_INTERVAL_SLOTS
docs: At most one buyback per coin per interval; the first at least this many
slots after launch.

constants.name: BUYBACK_MIN_HORIZON_RUNS
docs: V11 horizon for any trader.

constants.name: BUYBACK_MIN_HORIZON_RUNS_FOUNDER
docs: V11 horizon for an attacker credited his own share.

constants.name: COIN_DECIMALS
docs: Decimals of every coin (R8).

constants.name: COIN_SUPPLY
docs: 1,000,000,000 coins at 6 decimals, minted once per coin (R8).

constants.name: CONTINUITY_PPB
docs: V7: the pool opens at most this many parts per 10^9 below the curve's last
price, never above.

constants.name: FEE_RECIPIENT
docs: R9: the only destination of platform fees and launch fees. Changing it
needs a program upgrade.

constants.name: LAUNCH_LEAF_TAG
docs: Domain tag of a launch leaf (3.12): 26 ASCII bytes.

constants.name: LAUNCH_LEAF_VERSION
docs: Version byte of a launch leaf (3.12); a later layout takes 2.

constants.name: LEGACY_ADMIN_AT
docs: Offset of `admin` in the old program's `Launchpad` (8.5, GOV-1): it must
be this program's admin at every approval and launch.

constants.name: LEGACY_LAUNCHES_PAUSED_AT
docs: Offset of `launches_paused` in the old program's `Launchpad`.

constants.name: LEGACY_LAUNCHPAD
docs: The old program's global account, `find_program_address(["launchpad"],
LEGACY_PROGRAM_ID)` (mainnet build; unit test U12 checks the derivation).

constants.name: LEGACY_LAUNCHPAD_DISCRIMINATOR
docs: `sha256("account:Launchpad")[..8]`: the old program's `Launchpad`
discriminator (equal to this program's, the struct keeps its name).

constants.name: LEGACY_LAUNCHPAD_LEN
docs: Size of the old program's `Launchpad` (discriminator, five Pubkeys,
`launches_paused`, `payouts_paused`, `bump`).

constants.name: LEGACY_PENDING_ADMIN_AT
docs: Offset of `pending_admin` in the old program's `Launchpad`: it must be
zero at every approval and launch.

constants.name: LEGACY_PROGRAM_ID
docs: The old `vicinity_launchpad` program whose `Coin`, `Approval` and
`Launchpad` accounts are checked for R1 (mainnet build).

constants.name: MAX_BATCH_LEAVES
docs: Most leaves in one launch batch (8.6, 11.3).

constants.name: MAX_BATCH_PROOF_LEN
docs: Longest proof a batch launch accepts: `ceil(log2(MAX_BATCH_LEAVES))`.

constants.name: MAX_DUST_RAW
docs: Most raw units a config may burn at launch.

constants.name: MAX_FOUNDER_FEE_BPS
docs: A founder's share never exceeds 1.0% (V2); with the holders' share it is
never the whole fee (V2b).

constants.name: MAX_GRADUATION_LAMPORTS
docs: Largest graduation target, 10,000 SOL.

constants.name: MAX_LAUNCH_FEE_LAMPORTS
docs: R8 cap on a config's launch fee, 0.5 SOL.

constants.name: MAX_NAME_LEN
docs: Longest on-chain coin name (Metaplex limit), in bytes.

constants.name: MAX_PLATFORM_FEE_BPS
docs: Vicinity's own share never exceeds 1.2% (V2).

constants.name: MAX_SYMBOL_LEN
docs: Longest ticker (Metaplex limit), in bytes of `A-Z0-9`.

constants.name: MAX_TOTAL_FEE_BPS
docs: A config's five shares never add up to more than 2.5% (R2, V1).

constants.name: MAX_VIRTUAL
docs: Bound on `virtual_sol` and `virtual_tokens` (2^60).

constants.name: MERKLE_LEAF_PREFIX
docs: First byte of a leaf preimage (as `vicinity_rewards`' `merkle.rs`).

constants.name: MERKLE_NODE_PREFIX
docs: First byte of an inner-node preimage (as `vicinity_rewards`' `merkle.rs`).

constants.name: METADATA_URI_PREFIX
docs: Every coin's metadata URI is this prefix, the mint (base58) and ".json".

constants.name: METAPLEX_PROGRAM_ID
docs: Metaplex Token Metadata program (metadata for classic SPL coins).

constants.name: MEV_MAX_PERCENT
docs: V8: the conservative single-run bound is at most this percentage.

constants.name: MIN_GRADUATION_LAMPORTS
docs: Smallest graduation target, 1 SOL.

constants.name: MIN_TOTAL_FEE_BPS
docs: Smallest total fee of a config (V1), and the least a trader credited the
founder's share, the holders' share or both pays per leg (V2b).

constants.name: MIN_TRADE_LAMPORTS
docs: Smallest `sol_in` of a buy, 0.0001 SOL; sells have no minimum (O5).

constants.name: NATIVE_MINT
docs: Reward mint of every city's rewards vault (WSOL).

constants.name: PAYOUT_COOLDOWN_SECS
docs: At most one opted-in payout per coin per 24 hours.

constants.name: REWARDS_PROGRAM_ID
docs: Owner of every `vicinity_rewards` city config and vault the holders' share
may go to (mainnet build; the localnet tests load the real program here).

constants.name: REWARDS_REGISTRY
docs: The `vicinity_rewards` registry, `find_program_address(["registry"],
REWARDS_PROGRAM_ID)` (mainnet build; unit test U12 checks the
derivation). Its admin alone signs `init_city`, so it must be this
program's admin at every approval and launch (8.4, review OPS-1).

constants.name: REWARDS_REGISTRY_ADMIN_AT
docs: Offset of `admin` in the registry: it must be this program's admin at
every approval and launch (OPS-1).

constants.name: REWARDS_REGISTRY_DISCRIMINATOR
docs: `sha256("account:Registry")[..8]` of `vicinity_rewards` (OPS-1).

constants.name: REWARDS_REGISTRY_LEN
docs: Size of `vicinity_rewards`' `Registry` (discriminator, `admin`,
`pending_admin`, `bump`).

constants.name: REWARDS_REGISTRY_PENDING_ADMIN_AT
docs: Offset of `pending_admin` in the registry: it must be zero at every
approval and launch.
